# Clinical Quality Indicators

This folder contains specific clinical quality indicators used to measure and evaluate surgical outcomes within the Danish healthcare system. It currently houses the supplementary indicator for 30-day mortality following acute surgery among patients with no registered comorbidities. The pages detail the exact statistical findings, inclusion parameters, and exclusion criteria applied in national clinical databases to track these outcomes.

## Pages

- [[indikator-9a|Indikator 9a]] — Tracks the national 30-day mortality rate after acute surgery specifically for patients with a Charlson Score of 0, including detailed exclusion criteria and statistical confidence intervals.
